organ: organ 2b, the composition fix — organ 2 found composition nets on the telecom customers but hurts on the shop sessions. Fixed three ways at once, does it compose in both, and is it at least never worse than its best node?
why: Organ 2’s diagnosis, from its record: on the shop the coupling learned, on February–October, a negative weight for the browsing node (−0.33 against analytics’ 1.98), and in November–December that weight pulled the answer the wrong way (composed 0.791 against analytics alone 0.810). On telco, adding the weakest node (customer) lowered the test score slightly (0.8233 → 0.8221).
scenario: Three changes, measured together and apart. (1) A non-negative coupling (src/compose.mjs coupleNonNegative; Breiman 1996, Stacked Regressions): a node may add its word or be silent, never be counted against its own evidence — if a weight is below zero, the most negative node is silenced and the coupling learned again. (2) Co-growth (src/cogrow.mjs): the node with the best GATE score grows on its own; every next silo’s node is grown by the same seeded search (population 40, elites 8, generations 30), each candidate scored by the coupled AUC it adds on an inner split of its own FIT rows given the scores the nodes already in the mesh give those cases — only scores cross. (3) A gate on composition: a co-grown node joins only if it adds on GATE, out of fold (two folds); it carries the lowest bar a genome may (0.5), because its real gate is what it adds. Reported on TEST: A, organ 2’s mesh; B, organ 2’s nodes with the non-negative coupling; C, the fix (2 + 3, coupled as 1). The best single node is the best on TEST among every live node, alone-grown or co-grown.

rules.claim: no coupling weight is negative; every co-grown node that joined adds on GATE out of fold; the same mesh twice; TEST never read
COMPOSITION, RETAKEN: in both domains the fixed mesh (C) beats the best single node on TEST: bound above 0
SAFE: in both domains the fixed mesh is never worse than the best single node by more than 0.002: bound above −0.002
in both domains the fixed mesh is within 0.02 of every record pooled: bound above −0.02
the non-negative coupling alone (B) costs nothing where organ 2 already composed: in both domains not worse than organ 2’s mesh by more than 0.002 (bound above −0.002)

disclosure: Designed after organ 2’s verdict, knowing its numbers, which is why it is its own organ; organ 2’s verdict stands as it was. The expectation written before the run: H3 and H5 hold (the constraint stops the harm); H2 is genuinely open on the shop, where the analytics node carries most of the signal on its own; H4 is likely to fail, as it did in organ 2.
